title: 第3829章 说话如此粗鄙真不像一个女人第3828章 好狗不挡道
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 苏长歌嗤笑一声，满不在乎的道：“你确实没机会，因为你就算反悔，我也不会给你这个机会！”
一旁的紫月冷哼一声，不屑的道：“就凭你们这些蝼蚁，想要杀苏前辈，简直是不自量力，自讨苦吃，你们也不掂量掂量你们有几斤几两斤！”
“冤魂？看来你们平日没少干丧尽天良的事，不过老天有眼，今天让你们遇到我们，你们的好日子算是到头了，今日就是你们的死期！”叶清瑶冷着一张俊脸警告道。
那锦袍男子长的贼眉鼠眼的，一看就不是什么好人，仗着身边的几个侍卫修为高强，平日里肯定做了不少伤天害理之事。
锦袍男子轻笑一声，居高临下的道：“像你们这种自以为是，不知天高地厚的人，本公子见的多了，不管嘴上说的有多硬气，等真动起手来怂的要命！”
“本公子敢打赌，不出片刻的功夫，你们立刻就缴械投降，跪在地上向本公子我求饶！”
“向你求饶？你也配？别痴心妄想了，你怕是搞错了，向来只有别人向我求饶的份，断然没有我求别人。”苏长歌露出一丝嘲讽，霸气的怼了回去。
没听到想要的回答，锦袍男子有些不满：“说的比唱的还好听，有本事拿出实际行动来啊，到时候肯定会被我的手下打的，哭爹喊娘，生不如死，让你怀疑人生！”
“与其被我的手下打的跪地求饶，还不如现在就给本公子道歉，老老实实的跟公子打好关系，坐本公子身边的一条听话的狗，本公子保准不杀你！”
此刻的他，就像一个高傲的孔雀一般，丝毫没把苏长歌等人放在眼里。
紫月忍不住怒怼道：“苏前辈说了不会求饶的，你是听不懂人话吗？也是，做畜牲久了，听不懂人话是正常的。”
“紫月，骂的好，你那么会骂，多骂两句。”一旁的明月毫不吝啬的夸赞道。
“好嘞。”紫月笑着附和道。
随后，紫月火力全开，精神满满道：“苏前辈倒是想求饶，但他没这个机会啊，因为像你们这群垃圾，苏前辈随便动动手指都能解决掉，还怎么向你们求饶？”
“至于道歉，那更是痴心妄想，我们又没有做错任何事，为什么要道歉？是你们拦住了我们的去路，应该你们向我们道歉！”
“你这个小趴菜，还妄想让苏前辈给你道歉，给你当什么随从，你也配？也不拿个镜子照照你什么德行？反过来还差不多，但就你这长相，你给苏前辈当个奴仆，苏前辈都看不上，因为你长的太不堪入目了，看见你都倒胃口，什么好心情都没有了。”
她噼里啪啦一顿输出，疯狂一顿乱骂，骂完心里爽快极了。
锦袍男子被骂的面红耳赤，恼羞成怒，身躯都忍不住颤抖起来，指着紫月，气急败坏道：“你……你……”
紫月满脸嫌弃的道：“你什么你，三岁小孩吗？说个话都说不明白，结结巴巴的，真是太没用了，把舌头捋直了再说！”
闻言，锦袍男子的脸色越发难看，他感觉胸口发闷，气血上涌，显然被气的不轻。
“你这女子长的这般好看，怎么说话这么粗鄙不堪，真不像一个女人，本公子从未见过你这样牙尖嘴利的女子，从没哪个女子敢这般顶撞我，你敢这般顶撞羞辱本公子，是不是不想活了？
本公子即便在爱惜美人，今日也定然要将你给杀了，要不然本公子心里这口气就出不来！”
紫月冷哼一声，满不在乎的道：“想杀我，尽管来，我等着你，有本事你就杀了我，你要不杀，你就是狗熊！”
锦袍男子冷声喝道：“好，你给我等着，一个时辰之内你必死，本公子想要杀谁，还没有失手过！”
“你们你几个都愣着干什么？给本公子杀了这娘们！”
闻言，身边那四名侍卫心念一动，手中顿时浮现出一把锋利至极的长戟。
锦袍男子露出狠毒的笑容，道：“本公子改变主意了，让她死的太便宜可不行，先别弄死她，先将她活捉，本公子让你们乐呵乐呵，等你们乐呵够了再杀她，只有这样，才能解本公子心头之恨！”

content_en:
Su Changge sneered and said nonchalantly: "You really have no chance, because even if you regret it, I won't give you this chance!"
Ziyue on the side snorted coldly and said disdainfully: "You ants, if you want to kill Senior Su, you are simply overestimating your ability and asking for trouble. You don't even weigh how many kilograms you have!"
"Injustice? It seems that you have done many unscrupulous things on weekdays, but God has eyes. Today you meet us. Your good days are over. Today is the day of your death!" Ye Qingyao warned with a cold and handsome face.
The man in the brocade robe had a sinister look on his face, and he was not a good person at first glance. He must have done a lot of evil things on a daily basis due to the high cultivation level of the guards around him.
The man in the brocade robe chuckled lightly and said condescendingly: "Young master, I have seen too many people like you who are self-righteous and ignorant of the world. No matter how tough you say, you will be scared to death when you actually take action!"
"I dare to bet that in less than a moment, you will surrender immediately and kneel on the ground to beg me for mercy!"
"Begging for mercy from you? Are you worthy? Don't be wishful thinking. I'm afraid you are mistaken. Only others have begged me for mercy, and I have never begged others." Su Changge showed a trace of ridicule and retorted domineeringly.
Not hearing the answer he wanted, the man in brocade robes was a little dissatisfied: "What you say is better than what you sing. If you have the ability to take practical actions, you will definitely be beaten by my men when the time comes. You will cry for your father and mother. Life is worse than death. It will make you doubt your life!"
"Instead of being beaten by my men until you kneel down and beg for mercy, it is better to apologize to me now, establish a good relationship with me honestly, and sit next to me as an obedient dog. I will definitely not kill you!"
At this moment, he was like a proud peacock, not taking Su Changge and others seriously at all.
Ziyue couldn't help but angrily said: "Senior Su said that he would not beg for mercy. Don't you understand the human language? Yes, after you have been a beast for a long time, it is normal for you not to understand the human language."
"Ziyue, you're good at scolding. You're so good at scolding, so curse a few more times." Mingyue on the side praised him without hesitation.
"Okay." Ziyue agreed with a smile.
Afterwards, Ziyue turned on her fire and said with full energy: "Senior Su wanted to beg for mercy, but he didn't have the chance, because senior Su can get rid of trash like you with just a flick of his finger, so how can he beg for mercy from you?"
"As for apologizing, that's even more wishful thinking. We haven't done anything wrong, so why should we apologize? It's you who blocked our way, you should apologize to us!"
"You little loser, you still want Senior Su to apologize to you and be your follower. Are you worthy of it? Why don't you use a mirror to look at your virtues? The other way around is almost the same. But with your appearance, if you become a slave to Senior Su, Senior Su will not even look down on you, because you look so unsightly that even the sight of you makes you feel off-putting, and you are no longer in a good mood."
She spat out her words and cursed wildly, and after she finished cursing, she felt very happy.
The man in brocade robe blushed and became angry after being scolded. His body couldn't help but tremble. He pointed at Ziyue and said angrily: "You...you..."
Ziyue said with a look of disgust on her face: "What are you, a three-year-old child? You can't understand a word, you're stammering, it's so useless, straighten your tongue before you speak!"
Hearing this, the face of the man in brocade robes became more and more ugly. He felt his chest was tight and his blood was rising. He was obviously very angry.
"You are such a beautiful woman, but why do you speak so vulgarly? You really don't look like a woman. I have never seen a sharp-tongued woman like you. No woman has ever dared to contradict me like this. Do you not want to live anymore if you dare to contradict and humiliate me like this?
Even if I cherish the beauty, I will definitely kill you today, otherwise I will not be able to get out of my heart! "
Ziyue snorted coldly and said nonchalantly: "If you want to kill me, just come. I'll wait for you. If you can, kill me. If you don't, you'll be a bear!"
The man in brocade robes shouted coldly: "Okay, just wait for me. You will die within an hour. I have never failed to kill anyone I want to kill!"
"What are you guys doing standing there in a daze? Kill this bitch for me!"
Hearing this, the four guards around him thought, and an extremely sharp halberd suddenly appeared in their hands.
The man in brocade robe showed a vicious smile and said: "I have changed my mind. Let her die too cheaply. Don't kill her first. Capture her alive first. I will let you have fun. I will kill her when you have enough fun. Only in this way can you relieve the hatred in my heart!"
